name: GstarCAD Mechanical
tagline: Mechanical design add-on with library parts, BOM hooks, and drawing automation on the GstarCAD stack.
meta_desc: Targets machinery and factory documentation: standard parts, hole/tolerance helpers, and mechanical-specific palettes layered on top of core GstarCAD. Compare feature lists against your legacy ACM-style drawings if you migrate projects.

terms.title: Standard Parts Library
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Standard Parts Library inside GstarCAD Mechanical.
terms.definition: The Standard Parts Library simplifies manufacturing drafting by providing access to standardized fasteners, bearings, pins, and structural sections. It handles drawing scales and layer allocations automatically.
terms.why_matters: Enforces standardization across assemblies and cuts down drafting time for standard fasteners.
common_pitfalls: Inserting parts at incorrect scale factors relative to the sheet view
Failing to purge duplicate block definitions after library catalog updates

quiz.question: When working with Standard Parts Library, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Inserting parts at incorrect scale factors relative to the sheet view.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Inserting parts at incorrect scale factors relative to the sheet view.' As the editorial review notes: 'Enforces standardization across assemblies and cuts down drafting time for standard fasteners.'

terms.title: BOM Generation
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for BOM Generation inside GstarCAD Mechanical.
terms.definition: BOM Generation extracts components and sheet data into structured tables. It matches drawing markers directly to attributes, exporting items lists to Excel or factory software.
terms.why_matters: Prevents inventory counting errors and reduces handoff delays between design and assembly teams.
common_pitfalls: Overriding text inside the BOM table manually, which breaks dynamic sync with the components
Leaving part attributes blank or naming them inconsistently

terms.title: Hole and Tolerance Helper
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Hole and Tolerance Helper inside GstarCAD Mechanical.
terms.definition: The Hole and Tolerance Helper annotates clearances and fits automatically, resolving coordinate tolerance tables based on fit limits like H7/g6.
terms.why_matters: Ensures proper component fitment during machining assembly and reduces manufacturing reject rates.
common_pitfalls: Confusing local coordinate tolerance alignments with national standards
Applying custom manual dimension overrides that mask incorrect underlying geometry

faqs.question: How do I update the Part List after changing geometry?
faqs.answer: Run the `MCAD_UPDPART` command or select the BOM table and click Refresh. The system will automatically scan the drawing attributes and update the schedule.

faqs.question: Can I import standard parts from other catalogs?
faqs.answer: Yes, standard parts can be imported via the catalog manager. You can load custom ISO, DIN, and JIS standard libraries.

faqs.question: How to customize title blocks in GstarCAD Mechanical?
faqs.answer: Edit the template file under the configuration path. Modify the attributes within the title block block definition to bind them to your company standard properties.
